title: Services
description: Holistic healing, tarot card readings, and Vedic healing techniques with Priya.

hero.title:
Explore our holistic
healing services.
hero.body: Divinely charged techniques for what you are carrying. Each service is named before you begin, and the next step is a conversation with Priya.

items.title: Holistic healing
items.body: A session shaped around you. Priya works with the whole person, so the healing can reach mind, body, and spirit together.

items.title: Tarot card readings
items.body: A reading that helps you face what is already asking for attention, and leave with a clearer sense of the next step.

items.title: Vedic healing techniques
items.body: Guidance rooted in Vedic practice, including digital sessions, so the work can support real life and not only the hour itself.
points: In person or at a distance

items.title: Ritual, candle, and meditation
items.body: Hoodoo and candle magic rituals, plus meditation toward the higher self, when the right form is a practice rather than a single reading.

method.title: The same three moves, every time.
method.body: However the offer changes, the way Priya begins stays familiar.

items.title: Name the work
items.body: Holistic healing, a reading, a Vedic session, or a ritual. Said in a line you can repeat.

items.title: Shape it around you
items.body: The session follows your situation, not a script written for someone else.

items.title: Leave with a next step
items.body: A practice, a tool, or another conversation. One action, not a pile of advice.

closing.title: Ready to transform your life?
closing.body: Join a session and discover the healing practices that can guide you toward clarity and joy.
